rows.name: OrderId
rows.is: The identity the customer gives an order, so a retried order is the same order.

rows.name: AcceptedAt
rows.is: When the shop accepted an order.

rows.name: CustomerId
rows.is: A customer.

rows.name: Amount
rows.is: An amount of money in minor units, zero or more.

rows.name: Percent
rows.is: A share of an amount, in hundredths.

rows.name: ChargeId
rows.is: The payment provider's identity for a charge.

rows.name: Address
rows.is: Where a party is.

rows.name: ApiKey
rows.is: The secret a party knows the shop by.

rows.name: DeclineReason
rows.is: Why the payment provider declined.

rows.name: Outcome
rows.is: What became of an order the shop could not charge.

rows.name: Discount
rows.is: The share taken off an order.

rows.name: DiscountOffer
rows.is: The promotions system's discount for a customer.

rows.name: CardCharge
rows.is: A charge, as the payment provider accepts it; its ref is the order, so a repeat is one charge.

rows.name: ChargeApproved
rows.is: A charge the payment provider made.

rows.name: ChargeDeclined
rows.is: A charge the payment provider refused.

rows.name: Promotions
rows.is: The promotions system.

rows.name: Payments
rows.is: The payment provider; a transport error is the provider not answering.

rows.name: Order
rows.is: An order the shop accepted.

rows.name: ReadDiscount
rows.is: The shop asks for the customer's discount; the promotions system says a DiscountOffer.

rows.name: PricedOrder
rows.is: An order with its discount, and so what is due.

rows.name: Charge
rows.is: The shop charges what is due; the payment provider says ChargeApproved or ChargeDeclined.

rows.name: PaidOrder
rows.is: An order the payment provider charged.

rows.name: DeclinedOrder
rows.is: An order the payment provider refused.

rows.name: UnsettledOrder
rows.is: An order the shop could not charge, because the provider did not answer.

rows.name: CheckoutRequest
rows.is: A customer's order.

rows.name: OrderPriced
rows.is: What the shop says while it works: the price it will charge.

rows.name: OrderPaid
rows.is: The order was charged.

rows.name: OrderRefused
rows.is: The order could not be charged, and why.

rows.name: ShopConfig
rows.is: What the deployment names.
